cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes structured disambiguation, where users resolve ambiguity through explicit, constrained interactions instead of free-form dialogue clarification, and introduces the ARCS benchmark, which annotates naturally occurring ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries over real-world databases. Its value lies in turning ambiguity from a conversational burden into a reproducible input condition for evaluating intent misalignment in text-to-SQL deployment.
keyPointsEn: Proposes structured disambiguation: explicit, constrained interactions replace free-form dialogue clarification to resolve ambiguity in text-to-SQL.
Builds the ARCS benchmark: over real-world databases, annotating naturally occurring ambiguity points, corresponding interpretations, and SQL queries.
Experiments show text-to-SQL remains challenging under ambiguity: gpt-6-sol reaches 51% end-to-end execution accuracy, and no open-source model exceeds 27%.
cards.limitationsEn: The summary only reports end-to-end execution accuracy numbers for gpt-6-sol and open-source models, without specifying model versions, evaluation settings, prompting strategies, or statistical uncertainty; it provides no controlled comparison between structured disambiguation and conversational clarification, nor quantitative results on human efficiency or cognitive load. ARCS annotation consistency, coverage, database and question distribution, and whether it includes unresolvable or adversarial ambiguities are not described in the given text, so it cannot be concluded that this paradigm already outperforms existing clarification methods or applies to all real-world workflows.
cards.description: 该工作提出结构化消歧范式，要求用户通过受约束的交互显式选择歧义解释，而非自由对话澄清；并构建ARCS基准，首次在真实数据库上系统标注自然出现的歧义点、解释与SQL查询。其价值在于将歧义从“对话负担”转为可评测的输入条件，为文本到SQL部署中的意图偏离问题提供可复现的测试基础。
cards.title: 结构化消歧能否提升文本到SQL系统的准确率
cards.limitations: 摘要仅给出gpt-6-sol与开源模型的端到端执行准确率数字，未说明模型版本、评测设置、提示策略或统计不确定性；未提供结构化消歧相对对话澄清的对照实验或人工效率、认知负担的量化结果；ARCS的标注一致性、覆盖率、数据库与问题分布、是否包含不可消歧或恶意歧义等均未在给定文本中说明，因此不能据此断言该范式已优于既有澄清方法或适用于所有真实工作流。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If structured disambiguation and benchmarks like ARCS hold, text-to-SQL evaluation will move beyond translating unambiguous questions to explicitly measuring intent alignment and execution correctness under real, subtle ambiguity, helping locate silent deviations from user intent in deployment.
cards.whyItMatters: 若结构化消歧与ARCS这类基准成立，文本到SQL评测将不再只关注无歧义问题的翻译能力，而会显式衡量系统在真实、细微歧义下的意图对齐与执行正确性，有助于定位部署中悄然偏离用户意图的错误来源。
cards.originalTitle: ARCS: Towards Precise Text-to-SQL via Structured Disambiguation
keyPoints: 提出结构化消歧：用显式、受约束的交互替代自由对话澄清来消除文本到SQL中的歧义。
构建ARCS基准：面向真实数据库，标注自然出现的歧义点、对应解释与SQL查询。
实验显示歧义场景下文本到SQL仍具挑战：gpt-6-sol端到端执行准确率51%，开源模型均不超过27%。
cards.titleEn: Can Structured Disambiguation Improve Text-to-SQL Accuracy?
cards.summaryEn: The paper argues that as text-to-SQL systems move toward real-world deployment, ambiguity in user questions becomes a primary error source; such ambiguities are often subtle, domain- or data-specific, and can silently cause outputs to deviate from true intent, while traditional conversational clarification is inefficient, cognitively demanding, and misaligned with real workflows. The authors propose structured disambiguation, resolving ambiguity through explicit, constrained interactions rather than free-form dialogue. They construct ARCS, claimed as the first text-to-SQL benchmark featuring naturally occurring, unconstrained ambiguities over real-world databases, with complete annotations of all valid ambiguity points, interpretations, and SQL queries; experiments show the task remains challenging under ambiguity, with gpt-6-sol achieving only 51% end-to-end execution accuracy and no open-source model exceeding 27%.
cards.summary: 论文指出，文本到SQL系统走向真实部署时，用户问题中的歧义是主要错误来源，且歧义常细微、依赖领域或数据，可能悄悄使输出偏离用户真实意图；传统对话澄清效率低、认知负担重，也不贴合真实工作流。作者提出结构化消歧，即通过显式且受约束的交互解决歧义，而非自由形式对话。作者构建ARCS，宣称是首个在真实数据库上包含自然出现、未受约束歧义，并完整标注所有有效歧义点、解释与SQL查询的文本到SQL基准；实验显示歧义下任务仍困难，gpt-6-sol端到端执行准确率仅51%，开源模型均不超过27%。

cards.descriptionEn: Existing methods typically fix the optimizer's own tools and procedures, improving only the target agent's prompts, tools, and workflow. VERSE enables the optimizer to also improve how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests effects, using execution-based verification, failure replay, and step perturbation to enhance optimization. On SWE-rebench in-distribution and cross-language out-of-distribution tasks, its best validation-selected harness reaches 42.3% and 37.7%
keyPointsEn: In the controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification, but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available.
VERSE lets the optimizer test draft edits, replay failures, and perturb suspected steps before submission, while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds.

Under a shared protocol with disjoint training, validation, and test tasks, VERSE improves all four evaluated harness optimizers on held-out SWE-rebench tasks and newer out-of-distribution tasks in five languages.
cards.limitationsEn: The evidence comes from the paper's controlled study, shared protocol, and tasks from SWE-rebench and five languages; reported results include accuracy of the best validation-selected harness, and do not show generalization to other task distributions, other models, other verification mechanisms, or real production environments. The weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed, so the conclusions do not directly apply to settings involving weight updates.
cards.description: 现有方法通常固定优化器自身的工具与流程，仅改进被优化代理的提示、工具与工作流。VERSE 让优化器也能改进自身诊断失败、开发修改和测试效果的方式，并通过执行验证、失败重放与步骤扰动提升优化效果。在 SWE-rebench 同分布与跨语言分布外任务上，其最优验证集选择的执行框架准确率分别达到 42.3% 与 37.7%，优于最强基线 39.2% 与 29.3%。
cards.title: VERSE：可验证的自我进化优化器提升代理执行框架
cards.limitations: 证据来自论文设定的受控研究、共享协议以及 SWE-rebench 与五种语言的新分布外任务；报告结果包含验证集选择后的最优执行框架准确率，未说明在其他任务分布、其他模型、其他验证机制或真实生产环境中的泛化能力。优化器与执行器模型权重保持固定，因此结论不直接适用于涉及权重更新的场景。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work suggests that agent harness optimization can come not only from modifying the target agent but also from improving the optimizer's own diagnosis and verification process; mechanisms such as execution-based verification, failure replay, and step perturbation may improve optimization and can transfer across multiple harnesses and language tasks without changing model weights.
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作表明，代理执行框架优化不仅来自修改被优化代理，也可来自优化器自身的诊断与验证流程改进；执行验证、失败重放和步骤扰动等机制可能提升优化效果，并可在不改变模型权重的情况下迁移到多种执行框架和语言任务。
cards.originalTitle: VERSE: Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
keyPoints: 在受控研究中，优化器自我进化缺少执行验证时无法提升性能，具备验证时取得最佳结果。
VERSE 允许优化器测试草稿修改、重放失败、扰动可疑步骤，并跨轮次追踪修复与回归。
在共享协议与互不重叠的训练、验证、测试任务下，VERSE 在 SWE-rebench 留出任务和五种语言的新分布外任务上提升了全部四个被评估的执行框架优化器。
cards.titleEn: VERSE: A Verified Self-Evolving Optimizer for Agent Harnesses
cards.summaryEn: The authors study whether an optimizer can improve another agent more effectively by also improving how it diagnoses failures, develops edits, and tests their effects. In a controlled study, optimizer self-evolution fails to improve performance without execution-based verification but achieves the best result of that study when verification is available. Based on this, VERSE tests draft edits, replays failures, and perturbs suspected steps before submission while tracking fixes and regressions across rounds. The weights of the optimizer and executor models stay fixed; only the executor harness and the optimizer's own prompts, skills, tools, hooks, and notes are revised.
cards.summary: 作者研究优化器能否通过改进自身诊断失败、开发修改和测试效果的方式，更有效地提升另一个代理。受控实验表明，没有基于执行的验证时，优化器自我进化无法提升性能；有验证时则取得该实验中的最佳结果。基于此提出 VERSE，它在提交前测试草稿修改、重放失败并扰动可疑步骤，同时跨轮次追踪修复与回归。优化器与执行器模型权重保持固定，仅修改执行框架与优化器自身的提示、技能、工具、钩子和笔记。

cards.descriptionEn: The project connects real open-source spatial intelligence data to a browser-based 3D globe, offering a satellite-reconnaissance-like visualization; it is novel in combining live data with a photorealistic 3D globe as an interactive tool, useful for developers interested in geospatial visualization.
keyPointsEn: Runs in the browser, without installing specialized geospatial software locally
Uses real open-source spatial intelligence data rather than simulated data
Presents live spatial information on a photorealistic 3D globe
cards.limitationsEn: Generated only from the brief GitHub Trending project description; the data source, accuracy, licensing, update frequency, or practical usability are unverified. No performance metrics, user reviews, or comparisons with similar tools are provided, so its reliability or scope cannot be inferred from this input.
cards.description: 该项目将真实开源空间情报数据接入浏览器内的三维地球界面，提供类似卫星侦察的可视化体验；新在把实时数据与照片级三维地球结合为可交互工具，对关注地理空间可视化的开发者有用。
cards.title: 浏览器内开源卫星侦察模拟器呈现真实空间数据

cards.whyItMattersEn: The project offers a low-barrier interactive format for open-source geospatial visualization, potentially helping developers, researchers, or the public engage with public spatial data more intuitively. Its value depends on the reliability and update mechanism of the data source, for which no evidence is provided in the input.

keyPoints: 浏览器内运行，无需本地安装专业地理空间软件

在照片级三维地球上呈现实时空间信息
cards.titleEn: Browser-Based Open-Source Spy Satellite Simulator Uses Real Spatial Data
cards.summaryEn: The GitHub project gods-eye-view is described as a browser-based spy satellite simulator whose data is real rather than fictional. It presents live open-source spatial intelligence on a photorealistic 3D globe. These points come from the project description, with no technical details or validation provided.
cards.summary: GitHub 项目 gods-eye-view 被描述为一款浏览器内的侦察卫星模拟器，其数据来自真实空间情报而非虚构。它将实时开源空间信息呈现在照片级三维地球上。以上是项目自述，未提供技术细节或验证信息。

cards.descriptionEn: This work introduces a test-time framework that, without retraining policies, combines multiple frozen goal-conditioned policies into a portfolio, selecting the best policy at each state by imagining futures in a world model. Its novelty lies in comparing heterogeneous policies via a shared value function and avoiding excessive switching. On 18 state-based OGBench datasets, it improves macro-average success from 44% to 58%, offering a plug-and-play policy integration approach
keyPointsEn: WMPA takes a set of frozen goal-conditioned policies as input and requires no retraining or task-specific knowledge.
It rolls out each policy's imagined future in a world model, scores them with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval.

On 18 state-based OGBench datasets, macro-average success improves from 44% to 58%, with significant gains on 12 datasets, including +33 percentage points on cube-double-play and +36 percentage points on scene-play.
cards.limitationsEn: Experiments are limited to 18 state-based OGBench datasets covering maze navigation, cube, scene, and puzzle manipulation; WMPA relies on a bank of frozen goal-conditioned policies and a learned world model, so performance may depend on policy bank quality and world model accuracy; the paper does not address higher-dimensional visual inputs or real robots, nor does it discuss computational cost and the trade-off of switching frequency.
cards.description: 该工作提出一种测试时框架，无需重新训练策略，而是将多个冻结的目标条件策略组合成一个投资组合，在每个状态通过世界模型想象未来并选择最优策略执行。其新意在于用共享价值函数比较异构策略，避免切换过于频繁。在OGBench的18个状态数据集上，宏观平均成功率从44%提升至58%，为离线目标条件强化学习提供了一种即插即用的策略整合方案。
cards.title: 世界模型仲裁器整合冻结策略提升目标条件强化学习
cards.limitations: 实验限于OGBench的18个状态数据集，涉及迷宫导航、立方体、场景和拼图操作；WMPA依赖一组已冻结的目标条件策略和学习到的世界模型，其表现可能受策略库质量与世界模型精度影响；论文未说明在更高维视觉输入或真实机器人上的效果，也未讨论计算开销与切换频率的权衡。
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method offers a test-time policy combination approach that does not rely on a single best policy, potentially providing a reusable framework for policy selection and ensemble in offline reinforcement learning.
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法提供了一种不依赖单一最优策略的测试时策略组合思路，可能为离线强化学习中的策略选择与集成提供可复用的框架。
cards.originalTitle: World-Model Policy Arbiter for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
keyPoints: WMPA以一组冻结的目标条件策略为输入，无需重训练或任务特定知识。
通过在世界模型中展开每个策略的想象未来，用共享目标条件价值函数评分，选择最优策略执行短承诺区间。
在OGBench的18个状态数据集上，宏观平均成功率从44%提升至58%，12个数据集提升显著，包括cube-double-play +33个百分点和scene-play +36个百分点。
cards.titleEn: World-Model Policy Arbiter Integrates Frozen Policies for Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
cards.summaryEn: The paper notes that no single algorithm performs best across environments, goals, and task phases in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning. The authors propose World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA), which takes a set of frozen policies as input, rolls out imagined futures in a world model, scores them with a shared goal-conditioned value function, and executes the highest-scoring policy for a short commitment interval. Under the official OGBench protocol, WMPA improves the macro-average success rate from 44% to 58%, with significant gains on 12 datasets.
cards.summary: 论文指出离线目标条件强化学习中不存在单一算法在所有环境、目标和任务阶段都最优。作者提出World-Model Policy Arbiter (WMPA)，以一组冻结策略为输入，通过世界模型展开想象未来并用共享目标条件价值函数评分，选择最高分策略执行一段承诺区间。在OGBench官方协议下，WMPA将宏观平均成功率从44%提升至58%，12个数据集上提升显著。

cards.descriptionEn: Existing agent safety evaluations mostly focus on digital environments. This work introduces RT-SAFE, a simulated urban benchmark in which the world keeps evolving during inference and action execution, bringing decision latency into embodied safety assessment. Its value lies in showing that high task completion can mask safety failures and in offering an environment for offline RL training to reduce collisions.
keyPointsEn: RT-SAFE incorporates real-time constraints into embodied-agent safety evaluation: the world does not pause while the agent reasons, so an action that appears safe at observation time may become unsafe before execution.
Across eight VLMs, task completion is high but safe completion is extremely low, with only 0.7% of episodes finishing without a safety event in the hardest setting.

Matched static and real-time evaluations yield similar task completion rates (91.3% and 94.1%), but real-time execution increases collisions by about 12.3x, indicating that latency can translate into physical risk.
cards.limitationsEn: The work is based on a simulated urban environment, and its conclusions cannot be directly extrapolated to real roads or real robotic systems. It evaluates eight VLMs and does not represent all embodied-agent architectures. Safety events and collisions are defined and measured by the simulator, leaving real-world sensor noise, actuator errors, and complex human-agent interaction uncovered. The offline RL training demonstration shows improvement within this benchmark, not a guarantee of safety in real scenarios.
cards.description: 现有智能体安全评测多集中于数字环境，该工作提出模拟城市基准 RT-SAFE，让世界在推理与动作执行期间持续演化，从而把决策延迟纳入具身安全评估。其价值在于揭示任务完成率高并不代表安全，并可作为离线强化学习训练环境以降低碰撞。
cards.title: RT-SAFE：实时具身智能体安全评测基准
cards.limitations: 该工作基于模拟城市环境，结论不能直接外推到真实道路或真实机器人系统；评测覆盖八个视觉语言模型，不代表所有具身智能体架构；安全事件与碰撞由模拟器定义和度量，真实世界的传感器噪声、执行器误差与复杂人机交互未被覆盖；离线强化学习训练展示的是该基准内的改进，不等于真实场景安全保证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: As agents move from digital environments into the physical world, failures can cause human injury and hardware damage. This benchmark suggests that measuring embodied agents only by task success systematically underestimates safety risk and that real-time latency should be part of safety metrics. It can also support offline RL training, providing an evaluable path to reduce collisions under real-time constraints.
cards.whyItMatters: 随着智能体从数字环境走向物理世界，失败可能造成人身伤害与硬件损坏。该基准提示：仅以任务成功率衡量具身智能体会系统性低估安全风险，实时延迟应作为安全指标的一部分；同时其可支持离线强化学习训练，为在实时约束下降低碰撞提供可评测路径。
cards.originalTitle: RT-Safe: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environment
keyPoints: RT-SAFE 将实时性纳入具身智能体安全评测：世界不会因智能体推理而暂停，观测时安全的动作在执行前可能已不安全。
对八个视觉语言模型的评测中，任务完成率很高但安全完成率极低，最难设置下仅 0.7% 的回合无安全事件。
静态与实时匹配评估的任务完成率接近（91.3% 与 94.1%），但实时执行使碰撞增加约 12.3 倍，说明延迟可转化为物理风险。
cards.titleEn: RT-SAFE: Benchmarking Agent Safety in Real-Time Embodied Environments
cards.summaryEn: RT-SAFE is a simulated urban benchmark for evaluating embodied-agent safety under real-time constraints, combining navigation tasks with moving actors, environmental hazards, and traffic rules while allowing the world to evolve throughout inference and action execution. Across eight VLMs, task completion is high but safe completion is extremely rare: in the hardest setting, only 0.7% of episodes finish without a safety event, and matched static versus real-time evaluations yield task completion rates of 91.3% and 94.1% while real-time execution increases collisions by about 12.3x. The authors argue that standard task success can mask substantial safety failures and that decision latency itself can become a source of physical risk, and they show the benchmark can support offline RL training to substantially reduce collision rates.
cards.summary: RT-SAFE 是一个面向实时约束的模拟城市具身智能体安全基准，包含导航任务、移动角色、环境危险与交通规则，并允许世界在推理和动作执行过程中持续变化。对八个视觉语言模型的评测显示，任务完成率可达九成以上，但安全完成率极低，最难设置下仅 0.7% 的回合无安全事件；静态与实时对比中，实时执行使碰撞增加约 12.3 倍。作者认为，标准任务成功率可能掩盖严重安全失败，决策延迟本身可成为物理风险来源，并展示该基准可支持离线强化学习训练、显著降低碰撞率。

cards.descriptionEn: The GitHub trending project rea proposes using agents for reverse engineering, covering everything from app behavior down to native binaries. By delegating reverse-engineering workflows to agents, it may offer a more automated path for security analysis and program understanding.
keyPointsEn: Positioned as using agents to perform reverse engineering tasks.
Claims to cover from app behavior down to native binaries.
Sourced from GitHub Trending Daily, with no author or paper information.
cards.limitationsEn: Only the project title and a one-line description are available; there are no code details, benchmarks, experimental results, or independent reproductions. Its actual coverage, accuracy, and applicable boundaries cannot be judged, and it does not constitute any security or investment advice.
cards.description: GitHub 热门项目 rea 提出用智能体进行逆向工程，覆盖从应用行为到原生二进制文件。它把逆向流程交给智能体，可能为安全分析与程序理解提供更自动化的路径。
cards.title: 基于智能体的逆向工程工具 rea
cards.limitations: 仅有项目标题与一句话简介，没有代码细节、基准测试、实验结果或独立复现；无法判断其实际覆盖范围、准确率与适用边界，也不构成任何安全或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If feasible, this approach could reduce repetitive manual effort in behavior observation and binary analysis during reverse engineering, with potential value for security research, vulnerability analysis, and program understanding.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该思路可行，智能体可降低逆向工程中行为观察与二进制分析的重复性人力投入，对安全研究、漏洞分析与程序理解有潜在价值。
keyPoints: 项目定位是用智能体完成逆向工程任务。
声称覆盖范围从应用行为到原生二进制文件。
来源为 GitHub Trending Daily，缺乏作者与论文信息。
cards.titleEn: Rea: An Agent-Based Reverse Engineering Tool
cards.summaryEn: Rea is a project listed on GitHub Trending Daily whose description says it can reverse engineer anything with agents, ranging from app behavior down to native binaries. That description is the project's own positioning; its actual capabilities and effectiveness require verification through code and testing.
cards.summary: rea 是 GitHub Trending Daily 收录的一个项目，其简介称可用智能体逆向工程任何对象，范围从应用行为到原生二进制文件。该描述属于项目自我定位，实际能力与效果需由代码和实测验证。

cards.descriptionEn: This study addresses first-pass failures in locally deployed LLM-generated power-system simulation code, proposing a deployment-time workflow that requires no weight updates: documentation-driven L0-L3 probes build per-model API profiles, query-side demand estimation selects layered API evidence before generation, and execution feedback routes targeted repair. Its value lies in turning common API hallucination and parameter misuse into a diagnosable and calibratable engineeri
keyPointsEn: Releases PowerCodeBench, a frozen 2,000-task benchmark for pandapower, with documentation-driven L0-L3 probes that produce per-model API profiles.
Deployment-time workflow requires no weight updates: a query-side demand estimator selects layered API evidence, and execution feedback routes targeted repair.

Across ten open-weight LLMs (1.5B-480B) and four mid-tier APIs, the validation-enabled workflow raises scalar-match accuracy by 32-56 percentage points after up to three repair rounds; 70B-120B open-weight models reach the four-vendor mid-tier accuracy range under matched no-tool conditions.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit: results come from the authors' PowerCodeBench and specific pandapower tasks and should not be directly extrapolated to other libraries or domains; accuracy gains are measured under up to three repair rounds and validation-enabled conditions, so the benefit without validation needs separate evaluation; OpenDSS and PyPSA are only reported as round-0 pilots, constituting early motivational evidence; all comparisons are limited to ten open-weight models and four mid-tier APIs, not covering closed frontier models or broader toolchains; engineering review covers only model-item pairs passing numerical checks under both workflows, so the 88% versus 66% confirmation rates should not be generalized to all generated outputs.
cards.description: 该研究针对本地部署下LLM生成电力系统仿真代码时的首轮失败问题，提出无需更新权重的部署期工作流：先用文档驱动的L0-L3探测建立逐模型API画像，再在生成前按查询需求分层注入API证据，并用执行反馈定向修复。其价值在于把常见的API幻觉与参数误用转化为可诊断、可校准的工程流程，并在十款开源权重模型和四家API上验证了准确率提升。
cards.title: 电力系统代码生成的知识边界探测与按需干预
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：结果来自作者构建的PowerCodeBench及特定pandapower任务，不应直接外推到其他库或领域；准确率提升是在最多三轮修复和启用验证的条件下测得，未验证流程的增益需另行评估；OpenDSS与PyPSA仅报告第一轮试点，属早期动机性证据；所有对比限于十个开源权重模型和四个中端API，未覆盖闭源前沿模型或更广泛工具链；工程审查仅覆盖在两种工作流下均通过数值检查的模型-条目对，88%与66%的确认率不能推广到所有生成输出。
cards.whyItMattersEn: Power-system simulation code generation often demands on-premise deployment and is highly sensitive to API-call correctness and result-table handling. This work localizes first-pass failures to the API knowledge boundary and provides an actionable deployment-time diagnosis and intervention path, helping evaluate models, allocate documentation, and calibrate backends without weight fine-tuning, while offering a practical on-premise serving envelope for throughput, latency, energy, and allocated GPU memory.
cards.whyItMatters: 电力系统仿真代码生成往往要求本地部署，且对API调用正确性和结果表处理高度敏感。该工作把首轮失败定位到API知识边界，并给出可操作的部署期诊断与干预路径，有助于在无法微调权重的情况下评估模型、分配文档与校准后端，同时为吞吐、延迟、能耗和显存占用提供可参考的本地服务边界。
cards.originalTitle: Knowledge boundary probing and demand-guided intervention for LLM-based power system code generation
keyPoints: 发布PowerCodeBench：面向pandapower的2000任务冻结基准，并配套L0-L3文档驱动探测以形成逐模型API画像。
部署期工作流不更新权重：查询侧需求估计选择分层API证据，执行反馈用于定向修复。
在十个开源权重模型（1.5B-480B）与四个中端API上，启用验证的工作流经最多三轮修复将标量匹配准确率提高32-56个百分点；70B-120B开源模型在无工具条件下达到四厂商中端API准确率区间。
cards.titleEn: Knowledge Boundary Probing and Demand-Guided Intervention for LLM-Based Power System Code Generation
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors release PowerCodeBench, a frozen 2,000-task suite for pandapower, and propose a deployment-time workflow combining L0-L3 probing, query-side demand estimation, and execution-feedback repair without weight updates. Fact: Across ten open-weight LLMs (1.5B-480B) and four mid-tier APIs, the validation-enabled workflow raises scalar-match accuracy by 32-56 percentage points after up to three repair rounds relative to an unassisted first pass; selective injection approaches the full-layer reference using 41% of prompt tokens. Author view: such probing and demand-guided intervention can support diagnosis, model comparison, documentation allocation, and backend calibration, motivating staged onboarding from broad retrieval at cold start to calibrated selective injection.
cards.summary: 事实：作者发布PowerCodeBench（面向pandapower的2000任务冻结套件），并提出包含L0-L3探测、查询侧需求估计与执行反馈修复的部署期工作流，不更新模型权重。事实：在1.5B-480B的十个开源权重模型和四个中端API上，启用验证的工作流经最多三轮修复后，标量匹配准确率相较无辅助首轮提升32-56个百分点；选择性注入以41%提示词元接近全层参考。作者观点：这类探测与按需干预可用于诊断、模型比较、文档分配和后端校准，并支持从冷启动广泛检索逐步过渡到校准后的选择性注入。

cards.descriptionEn: Formalizes the systemic risk of agentic AI across six mathematical settings: from an expected-harm identity for expected loss and the non-diversifiable common exposure of a shared foundation model to an observability trichotomy and runtime-impossibility corollary for runtime guardrails, arguing the systematic component of agentic risk cannot be diversified away, detected away, or reversed and can only be met by ex-ante structural prevention.
keyPointsEn: A shared foundation model is a non-diversifiable common exposure whose expected-shortfall floor persists as the fleet grows, with a percolation threshold governing contagion.
Under a lever-assignment axiom that review cannot intercept an irreversible action, no non-preventive control satisfies a coherent tail constraint.
Modeling runtime guardrails as partially observed stochastic control yields an observability trichotomy, a detection floor, and, under commit exogeneity, a runtime-impossibility corollary.
cards.limitationsEn: This is an arXiv preprint; its conclusions rest on six abstract mathematical settings and their axiomatic assumptions rather than empirical study, and it provides no calibration data, real-market backtests, or regulatory implementation assessments. Its results on non-diversifiability, percolation thresholds, the observability trichotomy, and runtime impossibility depend on specific assumptions (such as the lever-assignment axiom and commit exogeneity); conclusions may change under different assumptions, and applicability to specific institutions, models, or markets requires separate verification.
cards.description: 将智能体AI的系统性风险在六个数学设定中形式化：从预期损失的期望-危害恒等式、共享基础模型的不可分散共同敞口，到运行时护栏的可观测三分法与不可能性推论，主张对智能体AI的系统性成分不可分散、不可检测清除或逆转，只能通过事前结构性预防应对。
cards.title: 智能体AI从模型风险到系统性风险
cards.limitations: 本文为arXiv预印本，结论建立在六个抽象数学设定及其公理假设之上，非实证研究，未提供校准数据、真实市场回测或监管落地评估。其关于无分散化、渗流阈值、可观测性三分法与运行时不可能性等结果依赖于特定假设（如杠杆分配公理、承诺外生性），换用不同假设后结论可能改变；对具体机构、模型或市场的适用性需另行验证。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the systematic component of agentic risk cannot be eliminated through diversification, detection, or post-hoc reversal, then regulatory frameworks relying only on runtime guardrails and ex-post review may be insufficient and may need to be repositioned toward ex-ante structural prevention. This provides a formal framework for discussing financial stability policy and the governance boundaries of agentic AI deployment.
cards.whyItMatters: 若智能体风险的系统性成分既不能通过分散、检测清除或事后逆转来消除，则仅依赖运行时护栏与事后审查的监管框架可能不足，需要重新定位为事前结构性预防。这为金融稳定政策与智能体AI部署的治理边界提供了形式化讨论框架。
cards.originalTitle: Agentic AI Systems and Financial Stability, From Model Risk to Systemic Risk
keyPoints: 共享基础模型是不可分散的共同敞口，其预期短缺下限不随群体规模增大而消失，渗流阈值决定传染条件。
在“审查无法拦截不可逆动作”的杠杆分配公理下，任何非预防性控制都无法满足一致的尾部约束。
把运行时护栏建模为部分可观测随机控制，得到可观测性三分法、检测下限，并在承诺外生性下给出运行时不可能性推论。
cards.titleEn: Agentic AI Systems and Financial Stability: From Model Risk to Systemic Risk
cards.summaryEn: This work argues that when many decision-makers depend on the same infrastructure, distress is no longer approximately idiosyncratic and diversifiable, so the binding concern shifts from the model risk of a single deployment to the systemic risk of the population. The authors formalize this across six mathematical settings: a shared foundation model is a non-diversifiable common exposure whose expected-shortfall floor does not vanish as the fleet grows, and a percolation threshold governs contagion. The authors' central claim is that the systematic component of agentic risk cannot be diversified away, detected away, or reversed, and only ex-ante structural prevention moves it.
cards.summary: 该研究主张，当大量决策者依赖同一基础设施时，困境不再近似个体化因而可分散，关注点从单一部署的模型风险转向群体层面的系统性风险。作者在六个数学设定中形式化该论点：共享基础模型构成不可分散的共同敞口，其预期短缺下限不随群体规模扩大而降低，并存在传染渗流阈值。作者的核心观点是：智能体AI风险的系统性成分无法被分散、检测清除或逆转，只能靠事前结构性预防。

cards.descriptionEn: These lecture notes introduce optimal transport as a mathematical language for actuarial science, treating losses, premiums, reserves, and climate losses as probability measures to be compared, transported, averaged, stressed, and interpolated. The novelty lies in systematically connecting optimal transport tools with actuarial problems such as risk measures, Wasserstein robustness, pricing, capital allocation, and longevity risk, while emphasizing the interpretation of model
keyPointsEn: Optimal transport models losses, premiums, reserves, climate losses, and lifetime distributions as probability measures, enabling comparison, averaging, stressing, and interpolation.
Core tools include couplings, push-forwards, discrete and continuous Kantorovich problems, duality, Wasserstein distances, quantile transport, barycenters, and entropic regularization.

Applications cover risk measures and Wasserstein robustness, pricing and capital, portfolio drift, reserving cash flows, climate-prevention diagnostics, reinsurance, dependence uncertainty, capital allocation, and longevity risk.
cards.limitationsEn: These are lecture notes and do not provide new empirical results or causal identification. All applications depend on modeling choices (state space, ground cost, ambiguity radius, reference distribution) and additional assumptions; transport maps and couplings represent distributional relationships and cannot automatically be interpreted as causal effects. Later chapters and appendices discuss counterfactual transport, dynamic formulations, unbalanced transport, and Schrödinger bridges, but the evidence boundary remains confined to methodological introduction and computational labs.
cards.description: 这篇讲义将最优传输引入精算学，把损失、保费、准备金和气候损失等视为概率测度，提供耦合、Wasserstein距离、重心和熵正则化等工具，用于比较、传输、平均、压力和插值分布。其新意在于系统性地将最优传输与风险度量、稳健性、定价、资本分配和长寿风险等精算问题结合，并强调建模选择（状态空间、成本函数、模糊半径、参考分布）的解释。
cards.title: 最优传输为精算科学提供分布比较与压力测试的新数学语言
cards.limitations: 讲义为课程笔记，不提供新的实证结果或因果识别。所有应用依赖于建模选择（状态空间、成本函数、模糊半径、参考分布）和额外假设；传输映射和耦合表示分布关系，不能自动解释为因果效应。后续章节和附录涉及反事实传输、动态形式、非平衡传输和Schrödinger桥等内容，但证据边界仍限于方法论介绍和计算实验。
cards.whyItMattersEn: For actuarial research, these notes provide a unified distributional framework that helps formalize uncertainty in robustness, fairness diagnostics, and stress testing. They highlight the impact of modeling choices, cautioning users to consider assumptions such as state space, cost function, and reference distribution, rather than interpreting transport results directly as causal effects.
cards.whyItMatters: 对精算研究而言，该讲义提供了一套统一的分布型分析框架，有助于在稳健性、公平性诊断和压力测试中更形式化地处理不确定性。它强调建模选择的影响，提醒使用者注意状态空间、成本函数和参考分布等假设，而非将传输结果直接解释为因果关系。
keyPoints: 最优传输把损失、保费、准备金、气候损失和寿命分布等建模为概率测度，从而支持比较、平均、压力和插值操作。
核心工具包括耦合、推前、离散与连续Kantorovich问题、对偶、Wasserstein距离、分位数传输、重心和熵正则化。
应用覆盖风险度量与Wasserstein稳健性、定价与资本、组合漂移、准备金现金流、气候预防诊断、再保险、依赖不确定性、资本分配和长寿风险。
cards.titleEn: Optimal Transport Offers a New Mathematical Language for Distributional Comparison and Stress Testing in Actuarial Science
cards.summaryEn: The notes argue that optimal transport can serve as a unified mathematical language for actuarial science, handling distributional objects. They are divided into two parts: first introducing tools such as couplings, Kantorovich problems, duality, Wasserstein distances, quantile transport, barycenters, and entropic regularization; then applying them to risk measures, robustness, pricing, capital, reserving, climate prevention, reinsurance, dependence uncertainty, and longevity risk. The author stresses that transport maps and couplings are distributional objects, not causal claims unless additional assumptions are imposed.
cards.summary: 讲义主张最优传输可作为精算学的统一数学语言，用来处理分布型对象。它分两部分：先介绍耦合、Kantorovich问题、对偶、Wasserstein距离、分位数传输、重心和熵正则化等工具；再应用于风险度量、稳健性、定价、资本、准备金、气候预防、再保险、依赖不确定性和长寿风险。作者强调传输映射和耦合是分布对象，除非额外假设，否则不构成因果主张。

cards.descriptionEn: DSTNet introduces a causal spectral trajectory representation that retains the recent evolution of wavelet filter-bank magnitudes rather than only denoising or using a single-point snapshot, combined with a scale-temporal factored Transformer and gated fusion. On seven equity indices and gold under an expanding-window protocol, the model beats the random-walk persistence benchmark in all 32 series-horizon cells, but paired testing is inconclusive against the strongest competi
keyPointsEn: Constructs a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory from seven trailing technical indicators over a twenty-day lookback using a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank with explicit left-boundary burn-in.
Uses a factorized Scale-Temporal Spectral Transformer, a learned gate fusing with a CNN-BiLSTM, and horizon-specific gates to emit 1, 3, 5, and 10 day forecasts in a single pass.
Across 32 series-horizon cells, persistence is the strongest of ten fixed competitors in 29 cells, and DSTNet is the only model below it in every cell.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence boundaries are explicit. First, this is based only on the abstract; dataset splits, hyperparameters, and computational cost are not provided. Second, paired testing at the one-day horizon is inconclusive against persistence and the strongest learned forecasters, so a general superiority claim is unsupported. Third, the downstream allocation diagnostic does not support a timing advantage on any of the seven indices, implying error improvements may not translate into tradable returns. Fourth, evaluation is limited to seven equity indices and gold, without other asset classes, market regimes, or longer horizons. Fifth, a single untouched one-year hold-out window is insufficient to establish robustness.
cards.description: DSTNet提出一种因果谱轨迹表示，保留小波滤波幅值的近期演化而非仅做去噪或单点快照，并配以尺度-时间分解Transformer与门控融合。在七个股票指数与黄金的扩展窗口测试中，该模型在全部32个序列-步长单元中优于随机游走持续性基准，但统计检验对最强持续性基准不具结论性，下游择时诊断亦未显示优势。
cards.title: DSTNet：用于因果多步金融预测的动态谱轨迹网络
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：首先，文章仅基于摘要，未提供数据集划分细节、超参数与计算成本。其次，统计检验在1日步长上对持续性基准和最强学习预测器不具结论性，因此不能宣称普遍优于最强竞争者。第三，下游配置诊断在七个股票指数上不支持择时优势，说明误差改进未必转化为可交易收益。第四，评估限于七个股票指数与黄金，未覆盖其他资产类别、市场状态或更长步长。第五，一年留出集虽未触碰，但单一样本外窗口不足以证明稳健性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If validated, the causal spectral trajectory design offers a modeling path for multi-horizon financial forecasting that does not sacrifice causality for spectral information, and it pushes research to distinguish clearly between beating weak learned baselines and beating a strong persistence benchmark. For quantitative researchers, its value lies in reporting statistical significance alongside a downstream allocation diagnostic rather than error metrics alone.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该因果谱轨迹设计成立，可为多步金融预测提供一条不以牺牲因果性换取谱信息的建模路径，并促使研究更严格地区分‘优于弱学习基线’与‘优于强持续性基准’。对量化研究者而言，其价值在于把统计显著性与下游配置诊断同时纳入评估，而非仅报告误差指标。
cards.originalTitle: DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting
keyPoints: 以二十日回看、七种技术指标和单边Morlet滤波器组构造因果动态谱轨迹，并显式处理左边界瞬态。
采用分解的尺度-时间谱Transformer、学习门控融合CNN-BiLSTM，以及按步长门控一次输出1、3、5、10日预测。
在32个序列-步长单元中，持续性基准在29个单元是最强固定竞争对手，DSTNet是唯一在所有单元低于它的模型。
cards.titleEn: DSTNet: Dynamic Spectral Trajectory Network for Causal Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting
cards.summaryEn: The work addresses the common limitation of wavelet-based financial forecasters that use the transform only for denoising or reduce it to a single spectral snapshot at the forecast origin, with a bilateral convolution that can read past that origin; it proposes a one-sided Morlet-derived filter bank with explicit burn-in to build a causal Dynamic Spectral Trajectory. Evaluated on seven equity indices and gold with an expanding-window protocol and an untouched one-year hold-out against nine learned baselines and a persistence benchmark, DSTNet is reported to be the only model below persistence under MAE and MAPE in every cell. The authors also report a negative downstream allocation diagnostic and do not claim an equity-timing advantage.
cards.summary: 该工作针对小波类金融预测器通常仅将变换用于去噪、或在预测原点仅取单一谱快照且卷积具有双边性（可越过预测原点）的问题，提出用单边Morlet滤波器组与显式burn-in构造因果动态谱轨迹。作者在七个股票指数与黄金上按扩展窗口与一年未触碰的留出集，对比九种学习基线和随机游走持续性基准，报告DSTNet在MAE与MAPE下均低于持续性基准。作者将下游资产配置诊断的负面结果也一并报告，未声称择时优势。

cards.descriptionEn: The work introduces the two-particle-irreducible effective action and Dyson-Schwinger gap equations from quantum field theory into stochastic-volatility option pricing as a non-perturbative closure. Its novelty lies in replacing Taylor truncation with the exact Gaussian moment-generating function for exponential and CEV vertices; in exp-OU the melon-level correction reduces the Hartree error by 20-130x to 0.01-0.11 bp. The method targets calibration, forward-start smiles, bar
keyPointsEn: A non-perturbative Gaussian closure for stochastic volatility pricing is built from 2PI effective action and Dyson-Schwinger gap equations; exponential vertices sum skeletons in closed form, with melon level cutting Hartree error to 0.01-0.11 bp.

The method separates Markovian models, where the gap equation collapses to a few ODEs, from rough (Volterra) models, where the full two-time propagator is retained, based on whether the dressed inverse propagator is time-local.
Rough Bergomi matches Monte Carlo references near H=0.07 and rho=-0.9; SABR reaches about 0.97 bp over a 72-cell grid with maturities to ten years, and rough SABR about 0.92 bp.
cards.limitationsEn: All accuracy figures (e.g., 0.01-0.11 bp, 0.97 bp, 0.92 bp) come from the author's benchmarks and ancillary technical supplement without independent replication; the method relies on Gaussian approximations and specific vertex treatments, so error bounds under extreme parameters, untested models or non-Gaussian features are unknown; no live data or market calibration results are provided, and trading costs, model risk or investment advice are not addressed.
cards.description: 该工作将量子场论中两粒子不可约有效作用与Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程引入随机波动率期权定价，构造非微扰闭包。其新意在于用指数和CEV顶点的精确高斯矩生成函数替代泰勒截断，在exp-OU中 melon 级修正将Hartree误差降低20-130倍至0.01-0.11 bp。方法可用于粗糙Bergomi、SABR与rough SABR的校准、远期起微笑和障碍期权定价以及vega风险，提供了一条统一处理校准、奇异期权与风险的路径。
cards.title: 粗糙波动率的Dyson-Schwinger有效作用方法：校准、奇异期权与风险的相关响应架构
cards.limitations: 所有精度数字（如0.01-0.11 bp、0.97 bp、0.92 bp）均来自作者基准与辅助技术补充，未经独立复现；方法依赖Gaussian近似与特定顶点处理，在极端参数、未测试模型或非高斯特征下误差边界未知；文中未提供实盘数据或市场校准结果，也未涉及交易成本、模型风险或投资建议。
cards.whyItMattersEn: If independently validated, the method could offer a unified framework for calibration, forward-start smiles, continuously-monitored barriers and vega computation for rough volatility, lowering computational dimensionality while approaching Monte Carlo accuracy. Its Dyson-Schwinger causal response block yields the impulse-vega curve directly, providing new analytical structure for risk management and exotic option pricing.
cards.whyItMatters: 若该方法经独立验证，可为粗糙波动率提供统一的校准、远期起微笑、连续障碍与vega计算框架，在保持接近蒙特卡洛精度的同时降低计算维度。其Dyson-Schwinger相关响应块可直接给出impulse-vega曲线，为风险管理和奇异期权定价提供新的解析结构。
cards.originalTitle: Dyson-Schwinger Effective-Action Methods for Rough Volatility: A Correlation-Response Architecture for Calibration, Exotics and Risk
keyPoints: 用2PI有效作用与Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程构造随机波动率定价的非微扰高斯闭包，指数顶点下骨架图闭式求和，melon级将Hartree误差降至0.01-0.11 bp。
该方法按传播子是否时间局部区分马尔可夫模型（间隙方程退化为少数ODE）与粗糙（Volterra）模型（保留全程两时间传播子）。
对粗糙Bergomi在H=0.07、rho=-0.9附近与蒙特卡洛参考精度相当，SABR在72格、10年内精度约0.97 bp，rough SABR约0.92 bp。
cards.titleEn: Dyson-Schwinger Effective-Action Methods for Rough Volatility: A Correlation-Response Architecture for Calibration, Exotics and Risk
cards.summaryEn: The author approximates the joint law of state variables via 2PI effective action and Dyson-Schwinger gap equations, summing skeletons in closed form for exponential vertices; for nonzero correlation, conditional Gaussian modes and moment matching handle integrated variance and leverage integral. The framework reduces Markovian volatility models to a few ODEs while retaining the full two-time propagator for rough models, and numerically matches Monte Carlo references for rough Bergomi, SABR and rough SABR. These findings rely on the author's benchmarks and ancillary technical supplement and require independent replication.
cards.summary: 作者提出以2PI有效作用与Dyson-Schwinger间隙方程近似状态变量联合律，在指数顶点下将骨架图闭式求和；在非零相关时通过条件高斯模与矩匹配处理积分方差和杠杆积分。该框架将马尔可夫波动率模型化为少数ODE，粗糙模型保留全程两时间传播子，数值上对粗糙Bergomi、SABR和rough SABR达到与蒙特卡洛参考相近的精度。上述结论基于作者提供的基准与辅助技术补充，尚需独立复现验证。

cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a stochastic portfolio theory framework in which trading strategies are generated from nominal price weights and evaluated against a price-weighted benchmark. Its novelty lies in incorporating split- and reverse-split-induced jumps in generating weights into the self-financing condition and providing explicit jump-corrected wealth decompositions; it is useful because it shows that the usual long-horizon relative arbitrage argument does not extend directly
keyPointsEn: Stock splits and reverse splits induce jumps in generating weights without changing the value of existing investments, requiring share adjustments to be included in the self-financing condition.

Under additive generation, an entropy-based example shows that repeated splits can drive relative wealth to negative infinity almost surely, so the long-horizon relative arbitrage argument cannot be applied directly.

Wealth-preserving restarts in multiplicative generation retain the classical portfolio allocation evaluated at current price weights; conversion to the capitalization-based framework preserves absolute wealth and is strategy-independent.
cards.limitationsEn: The abstract does not specify whether the model assumptions cover all real-world split and adjustment events, nor whether the empirical illustration is statistically significant; the entropy-based counterexample and the no-model-free-guarantee conclusion depend on the specific generation method and predictable adjustment setting and cannot be generalized directly to all strategies or markets; this is not investment advice, and practical application requires independent validation of data and execution assumptions.
cards.description: 该研究提出一个以名义价格权重生成交易策略、并以价格加权基准评估的随机投资组合理论框架。其新意在于把拆股与反向拆股引发的生成权重跳跃纳入自融资条件，并给出带跳跃修正的财富分解；其有用性在于说明传统长期相对套利论证在重复拆股下不能直接移植，并建立与市值加权框架的财富保持转换。
cards.title: 基于价格的随机投资组合理论框架：拆股调整下的策略生成与基准转换
cards.limitations: 摘要未给出模型假设是否覆盖所有现实拆股与调整事件的完整条件，也未说明实证是否具有统计显著性；熵型反例与无模型保证的结论依赖特定生成方式与可预测调整设定，不能直接推广为所有策略或所有市场的普遍结论；文中不构成投资建议，实际应用需自行验证数据与执行假设。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework explicitly incorporates price weights and split adjustments into stochastic portfolio theory, helping clarify the evaluation boundary of strategies under a price-weighted benchmark and the impact of split events on the long-term relative performance of generated portfolios, while providing structure for comparing price-weighted and capitalization-weighted approaches.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架把价格权重和拆股调整显式纳入随机投资组合理论，有助于理解价格加权基准下的策略评估边界，并澄清拆分事件对生成组合长期相对表现的影响，为比较价格加权与市值加权方法提供结构。
cards.originalTitle: A Price-Based Framework for Stochastic Portfolio Theory
keyPoints: 拆股和反向拆股会在生成权重中造成跳跃，但不改变既有投资价值，需把股份调整纳入自融资条件。
加性生成下熵型例子显示，重复拆股可导致相对财富几乎必然趋于负无穷，长期相对套利论证不能直接套用。
乘性生成的财富保持重启保留按当前价格权重评估的经典组合配置；与市值加权框架的转换保持绝对财富且基准转换与策略无关。
cards.titleEn: A Price-Based Framework for Stochastic Portfolio Theory: Strategy Generation and Benchmark Conversion under Split Adjustments
cards.summaryEn: In a semimartingale market with predictable adjustment events, the paper writes share adjustments from splits into the self-financing condition and constructs additively and multiplicatively generated strategies with explicit jump-corrected wealth decompositions. The authors show that under additive generation an entropy-based example has relative wealth tending to negative infinity almost surely under repeated splits, and that advance adjustment information alone provides no model-free guarantee of improved performance. They also establish a correspondence with the capitalization-based framework that preserves absolute wealth and yields a strategy-independent benchmark conversion, illustrated with daily NYSE data.
cards.summary: 论文在可预测调整事件的半鞅市场中，将拆股对应的股份调整写入自融资条件，构造了加性与乘性生成策略及显式跳跃修正财富分解。作者证明，加性生成下熵型例子在重复拆股时相对财富几乎必然趋于负无穷，并指出仅凭提前调整信息无法获得模型无关的业绩改进保证。作者还给出与市值加权框架的对应关系，保持绝对财富并产生策略无关的基准转换，并用日度纽交所数据作说明。

cards.descriptionEn: The study proposes a Dirichlet mixed-membership model that extends classical credibility theory from conditional means to multivariate distributions, enabling insurers to combine portfolio priors and individual experience posteriors exactly.
keyPointsEn: DMMM represents policyholder risk as a stable composition over latent risk classes via a Dirichlet mixed-membership structure, with baseline characteristics determining the prior and multivariate experience updating the posterior.

Support-specific expert distributions accommodate heterogeneous outcomes, dependence is induced through the shared latent structure, and the posterior predictive distribution is exactly a convex combination of portfolio and experience components.

Simulation shows that relatively simple experts can capture complex multivariate insurance distributions and learn policyholder-specific risk as experience accumulates; in a vehicle telematics application, recent claims and driving behaviour provide complementary information.
cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on a simulation experiment and a single vehicle telematics application, not yet validated on large-scale multi-line real portfolios; the choice of expert distributions and number of latent classes may affect results, and computational complexity and parameter estimation uncertainty are not discussed.
cards.description: 该研究提出Dirichlet混合隶属模型，将经典信度理论从条件均值扩展到多元分布层面，使保险公司能精确结合组合先验与个体经验后验。
cards.title: Dirichlet混合隶属模型实现多元分布信度定价
cards.limitations: 文中的证据基于模拟实验和单一车辆远程信息处理应用，尚未在大规模多险种真实组合中验证；专家分布的选择和潜在类别数设定可能影响结果，且未讨论计算复杂度与参数估计不确定性。
cards.whyItMattersEn: The framework preserves the interpretability of classical credibility while generalizing credibility weighting from means to full multivariate distributions, helping insurers use heterogeneous experience for more granular individualized pricing.
cards.whyItMatters: 该框架在保留经典信度可解释性的同时，将信度加权从均值推广到完整多元分布，有助于保险公司利用异质经验进行更精细的个体化定价。
cards.originalTitle: A Dirichlet Mixed-Membership Model for Exact Multivariate Distributional Credibility
keyPoints: DMMM通过Dirichlet混合隶属结构将投保人风险表示为潜在风险类别上的稳定构成，基线特征决定先验，多元经验更新后验。
支持特定专家分布可容纳异质结果，依赖关系通过共享潜在结构诱导，后验预测分布精确等于组合成分与经验成分的凸组合。
模拟实验表明简单专家分布能捕捉复杂多元保险分布并随经验积累学习个体风险；车辆远程信息处理应用中近期索赔与驾驶行为提供互补信息。
cards.titleEn: Dirichlet Mixed-Membership Model for Exact Multivariate Distributional Credibility
cards.summaryEn: Credibility theory combines individual experience with portfolio information for insurance pricing, but classical formulations focus primarily on conditional means and expected premiums. The authors propose a Dirichlet mixed-membership model (DMMM) for multivariate distributional credibility, representing policyholder risk as a stable composition over latent risk classes, with baseline characteristics determining the a priori assessment and repeated multivariate experience progressively updating the a posteriori assessment. The resulting posterior predictive distribution can be written exactly as a convex combination of portfolio and experience components, extending the credibility-factor structure beyond the conditional mean.
cards.summary: 信度理论用于保险定价，但经典方法主要针对条件均值和期望保费。作者提出Dirichlet混合隶属模型（DMMM），用潜在风险类别上的稳定构成表示投保人风险，基线特征决定先验评估，重复多元经验逐步更新后验评估。后验预测分布可精确写成组合成分与经验成分的凸组合，从而将信度因子结构推广到条件均值之外。
